narrative.headline: Top 50 flashing broad-based accumulation with 30 mega-caps bullish and only 7 bearish — dominant risk-on tape led by mega-cap tech, energy, and defensives.
bullish_setups: LLY: composite 9.34, near-perfect darkpool 10.0 + $274M premium and blocks 9.73 signal aggressive pharma accumulation
NVDA: flow $33.8M and darkpool $1.38B (10.0) with max blocks — semi leadership positioning intact
TSLA: flow $27.5M + darkpool $311M and blocks 10.0, composite 9.19
XOM: flow 8.49 + darkpool $424M (10.0) and blocks 10.0 — energy being quietly loaded
C: flow $10.7M + darkpool $539M — financials bid despite MS/AXP weakness
AAPL/MSFT/META/AMZN: all >8.4 composite with $750M–$1.4B darkpool prints, mega-cap tech accumulation is uniform
INTC: flow $26M and darkpool $483M (10.0), stands out vs bearish AMAT/KLAC/MU
PM/KO/ABBV: defensive names all >9.0 composite — barbell alongside tech
CAT: flow $15.5M + darkpool $342M, industrial cyclical bid
bearish_setups: AMAT: flow 3.36, KLAC flow 2.99, MU flow 1.11 — semi-cap equipment being distributed even as NVDA/INTC accumulate
MS: flow 2.79 diverging from bullish C — bank flows bifurcating
AXP 1.53 and MA 1.55: payments/consumer credit under pressure
GEV: flow 0.72, weakest name in the tape
HD/NFLX/RTX: lean bearish flow 4.19–4.51 despite strong darkpool — consumer discretionary and defense softening
narrative.rotation_signal: Rotation into mega-cap tech (ex semi-cap equipment), energy, defensives (LLY/PM/KO/ABBV), and out of payments (MA/AXP), semi-cap equipment (AMAT/KLAC/MU), and select financials (MS). The barbell of Big Tech + staples/pharma suggests institutions are positioning for continued index leadership without embracing full cyclical breadth.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semiconductor complex is split: NVDA/INTC bullish while AMAT/KLAC/MU bearish — Top 50 read favors chip designers/foundry over equipment, which may conflict with a uniformly bullish semis industry signal. Financials also bifurcated: C bullish vs MS/AXP bearish.
